inputs.product: The evolving target product specification at a recorded source revision.
inputs.roadmap: The milestone sequence and the selected milestone at the same source revision.
inputs.acceptance: Concrete scenarios linked by the selected milestone.
inputs.ontology: The product ontology commit pinned by the requesting product repository.

authority.product_governor: Adopts or revises product requirements and resolves conflicts.
authority.factory: Chooses architecture, libraries, task breakdown and verification methods within the selected milestone.

run.revision: Record immutable commits for the product, ontology and factory contract before execution.
run.scope: Work toward the selected milestone and relevant regressions; assess progress toward the full target specification separately.
run.conflict: Return affected declarations to the product governor with a proposed resolution.
run.accounting: Record forecast or estimation gap before the run; link actual resource observations and reconciliation gaps to the run afterward.

result.candidate: Runnable revision and replay instructions, or a named blocker.
result.evidence: Expected and observed results for each linked scenario, including any device trial that cannot run in the factory environment.
result.remaining_work: Unresolved assumptions, failing scenarios and distance from the full product target.
